label: Orange & Green
_shapeNote: UNUSUAL SHAPE — READ BEFORE WIRING IT UP. (1) `enemy` is deliberately the CONTROLLER. obj_orange_enemy and obj_green_enemy are the two visible obj_monsterparent enemies (scr_encountersetup.gml:826-836, encounter 221, monstertypes 113/114) but neither contains one line of attack code — obj_orange_enemy_Step_0.gml is 513 lines of ACT dialogue plus the omelet-punch minigame, obj_green_enemy_Step_0.gml is 766 lines of pure ACT dialogue. obj_orange_enemy_Create_0.gml:32 does `instance_create(x, y, obj_orange_green_controller);` and that controller owns the box, the turn timer, the dispatcher, the phase state and the finale. Box block, dispatcher and finale ALL read controller instance variables (powerup, healing_egg_con, endcon, condescendending, admireending), so every slice MUST be replayed with self = an obj_orange_green_controller instance or it throws. (2) There is NO `monsterattackname` ANYWHERE in this fight — not in either enemy, not in the controller, not in the type 131/132/307/314 branches of obj_dbulletcontroller (verified: `grep -n monsterattackname` over all six files returns nothing). gen_attacks.js's announcement scan finds ZERO attacks no matter what you put in `enemy`; the roster below is declared, not scanned. (3) selectorScan is NOT applicable: this is not Ch1-style `if (var == N) spawn`. The per-turn dispatcher is a BOOLEAN — `if (i_ex(obj_orange_enemy) && obj_orange_enemy.uppercut_life < 1) {314} else {131}` — and the finale dispatcher branches on two booleans, `condescendending` / `admireending`. There is no numeric selector to scan. (4) obj_orangeheart_enemy is NOT part of this fight — see `exclusions`.

boxBlock.note: Step_0:514-538, sliced by ifStatementEnd (no endAnchor needed — the block is brace-balanced, line 538 closes it). Anchor verified unique (grep -cF == 1). Creates obj_growtangle at (viewX+320, viewY+170) then forces `maxxscale = 1.5` — obj_growtangle_Create_0.gml:13-14 defaults maxxscale = maxyscale = 2, so the regular turns get a NARROWED box (spr_battlebg_0 is 75x75 origin 37,37 -> 112.5 x 150 px) while maxyscale stays at the default 2. Also carries scr_moveheart(), the base scr_turntimer(90) and `global.mnfight = 2`. THE HEALING-EGG TRAP: the growtangle create is the THIRD arm of an if/else-if chain whose first two arms test `global.monsterhp[...] < global.monstermaxhp[...] * 0.7`. If the studio replays this with monsterhp unpopulated (0/undefined) the chain takes arm 1, sets healing_egg_con = 1 and NEVER CREATES THE BOX or the soul. Seed global.monsterhp[myself] = global.monstermaxhp[myself] for both enemies (or clear healing_egg_con and force the third arm) before replay. `if (powerup == 4)` inside the block is DEAD — see cut[].

boxBlockFinale.note: The two FINALE attacks (types 132 and 307) do NOT use the regular box block. They are set up inside `if (endcon == 2.5) { if (endtimer == 1) { ... } }` and there is NO `maxxscale = 1.5` here, so the finale box is the untouched default obj_growtangle at 2x2 (150 x 150 px). Supplied as literal source rather than an anchor because `if (endtimer == 1)` occurs 5 times in the file (Step_0:775, 837, 1117, 1186, 1315) and `scr_turntimer(90);` occurs twice (535, 845) — neither is a safe anchor. Type 132 then lerps `obj_growtangle.image_xscale` to 3 over 30 frames (obj_attack_orange_superattack_Draw_0.gml:34-35) and type 307 swaps `obj_growtangle.sprite_index` and `mask_index` to spr_battlebg_round (obj_omega_pan_manager_Create_0.gml:4-5, an 80x80 circle) — the box turns ROUND for the OMEGA PAN.

dispatchBlock.note: Step_0:573-614, the WHOLE per-turn dispatcher, sliced by ifStatementEnd (brace-balanced; no endAnchor — do NOT slice to `if (global.mnfight == 2 && global.turntimer <= 1 && endcon == 0)` because Step_0:615 closes the enclosing bullets-phase if and the slice would carry a stray `}`). Anchor verified unique (grep -cF == 1). Self-selects on obj_orange_enemy.uppercut_life and carries BOTH scr_turntimer calls. Replay this INSTEAD of manually spawning a controller — never in addition (the Knight double-spawn trap). Requires obj_orange_enemy to exist and healing_egg_con == 0 on self.

finaleDispatchBlock.note: Step_0:849-879, the finale dispatcher, sliced by ifStatementEnd (brace-balanced). Anchor verified unique (grep -cF == 1). Branches on the controller's own `condescendending` / `admireending` booleans, so the studio sets ONE of them true on the controller instance to pick type 132 vs type 307 — there is no controller-side flag like Jevil's joker = 1.

turnBlockNote: This fight has NO separate turn-length ladder. Every scr_turntimer call lives INSIDE a dispatcher branch, interleaved with the `instance_create(..., obj_dbulletcontroller)` calls (Step_0:595, 605, 861, 874), so no slice can set the turn length without also re-spawning the controller. The only standalone scr_turntimer is the base `scr_turntimer(90)` at Step_0:535, which is already inside boxBlock and is the wrong value for every real attack. Use `turnByType` below, or replay `dispatchBlock` / `finaleDispatchBlock` verbatim (they carry the right values themselves). Without it every attack falls back to the studio's 90-frame floor: Cooking Time then terminates at frame 90 of a 270-frame turn, and Orange's uppercut loop (which reads `global.turntimer < 64` to decide whether to keep jumping) retreats on its very first cycle.

turnByType.note: 131 needs the external scr_turntimer(270) at Step_0:605 — obj_attack_green_cookingtime never sets global.turntimer itself, it only READS it (Draw_0:197 destroys itself at `global.turntimer < 1`). 314 is self-sufficient: obj_dbulletcontroller_Step_0.gml:3577 does a DIRECT `global.turntimer = 360;` (an assignment, so it lowers as well as raises) which matches the dispatcher's scr_turntimer(360). 132 is self-sufficient and OVERRIDES the dispatcher: obj_dbulletcontroller_Step_0.gml:1626 does `global.turntimer = 615;` while Step_0:861 only asked for 300, so the real Orange finale is 615 frames, not 300. 307 needs the external scr_turntimer(500) at Step_0:874 — obj_omega_pan_manager never touches global.turntimer. `base` 90 is the floor set in boxBlock. TYPE 131 IS FURTHER REWRITTEN MID-TURN by obj_orange_enemy_Step_0.gml:623-637 and :816 — see mechanics.

perTurn.note: The complete per-turn chooser. Two arms, no numeric selector. `uppercut_life` is the only input; when healing_egg_con != 0 NO controller is created at all (the HEALING EGG turn replacement).

finale.note: `condescendending` is set (and endcon = 1) at Step_0:117-126 when `global.mercymod[obj_orange_enemy.myself] >= 100`; `admireending` at Step_0:128-137 when `global.mercymod[obj_green_enemy.myself] >= 100`. Orange is tested FIRST, so if both cross 100 on the same ACT the condescend ending (type 132) wins. Step_0:706-708 is a second endcon = 1 trigger at the end of a bullet turn that sets NEITHER flag — see mechanics.

real.name: COOKING TIME — Green's FAST FOOD (falling eggs/donuts/candy + green flame bullets)
real.evidence: gml_Object_obj_orange_green_controller_Step_0.gml:597-606 — the `else` arm of the ONLY per-turn dispatcher, reached whenever obj_orange_enemy.uppercut_life >= 1 and healing_egg_con == 0. uppercut_life starts at 5 (obj_orange_enemy_Create_0.gml:15) and is reset to 5 after every type 314 (Step_0:592-593), so type 131 is ALWAYS the first bullet turn of the fight and is the default every turn thereafter. obj_dbulletcontroller_Step_0.gml:1588-1597 hides obj_green_enemy and creates obj_attack_green_cookingtime. THAT OBJECT HAS NO STEP EVENT — its entire logic is in gml_Object_obj_attack_green_cookingtime_Draw_0.gml (198 lines). Shape: every `timermax` frames it drops one item at one of three landing spots (landingspot_x[0..2] = camerax()+272/306/336, or +283/318/352 when powerup == 2; Create_0:23-32). Every 3rd drop (`(mode2count % 3) == 0`, unless powerup == 5) is a HARMFUL obj_regularbullet with spr_bullet_green_flame, damage 96, target 4, gravity 0.35 (Draw_0:54-79). The other drops are obj_bullet_healing FOOD (Draw_0:123-190): foodtype 0 = spr_bullet_green_egg (gravity 0.35, scr_doom 80), foodtype 1 = spr_donut_bullet (bounces wall to wall, vspeed -14 - random(6)), foodtype 2 = spr_swatchling_platter_candy (lerped to a box edge, telegraphed). Collecting food heals ALL THREE heroes 1 HP and gives TP (obj_bullet_healing_Step_0.gml:99-207, scr_healall(1) + scr_tensionheal); MISSING it lets Orange punch it (see mechanics). powerup drives timermax: 0/1/2/3/5 -> 12/13/10/6/10 (Draw_0:7-27) and foodtype: 0 -> 0, 1 -> alternates 1/0, 2 -> 2, 3 -> 0, 5 -> alternates 1/0 (Draw_0:86-121). The controller also raises the soul's speed for this type: powerup >= 1 -> obj_heart.wspeed = 7, powerup >= 5 -> 10 (Step_0:24-52; default wspeed = global.sp = 4, obj_heart_Create_0.gml:2).

real.name: OMEGA-3 uppercut — Orange leaps the box and slams down expanding glove rings
real.evidence: gml_Object_obj_orange_green_controller_Step_0.gml:582-596 — the `if` arm, reached when obj_orange_enemy.uppercut_life < 1. uppercut_life starts at 5 and drops by 1 every time a food item falls past `obj_growtangle.y + 100` during a type-131 turn and Orange punches it (obj_orange_enemy_Step_0.gml:541-594), clamped at -3. So this attack fires on the turn AFTER the player lets 5+ foods through, then Step_0:592-593 resets uppercut_life to 5. Fully reachable and repeatable. obj_dbulletcontroller_Step_0.gml:3567-3712: `difficulty` is pinned to 8 by the dispatcher (the branch's own `if (difficulty == 0) difficulty = 9;` default is therefore DEAD for this fight) and becomes obj_glove_manager.bullets, i.e. 8 gloves per ring. Every 56 frames Orange lerps to (growtangle.x +/- (56 + random(24)), growtangle.y - 144 + random(20)) with afterimages, punches at %56 == 22 (spr_orange_screenpunchfist bulletparent flash), and at %56 == 25 drops an obj_glove_manager whose event_user(0) rings `bullets` obj_orange_glove around it (obj_glove_manager_Other_10.gml). The ring falls at `vspeed -> 0.7 + obj_heart.wspeed / 2` and its radius pulses `(90 + 33*sin(expand)) * grow` while each glove orbits at `turn / dist` (obj_glove_manager_Step_0.gml). At %56 == 30 the controller does `mytimer += 3 * (obj_heart.wspeed - 4)` — the FASTER the soul, the faster the next punch. `gloveflip` alternates sides. `running` goes false once `global.turntimer < 64`, which is how Orange retreats; a wrong turntimer breaks that. Decompiler artifact at :3576: `orange = 402;` is the raw object id of obj_orange_enemy (objects.tsv line 404, header at line 1 -> id 402), then `bspr = orange.sprite_index;` reads it object-scoped. Controller also sets the soul speed: powerup >= 1 -> wspeed 5, >= 3 -> 6, >= 5 -> 7 (Step_0:54-82).

real.name: OMEGA-3 SUPER ATTACK — Orange's finale (condescend / Orange-mercy ending)
real.evidence: gml_Object_obj_orange_green_controller_Step_0.gml:854-862, inside `if (endcon == 2.5) { if (endtimer == 12) { ... } }`. Reached only when `condescendending` is true, which is set at Step_0:117-126 when `global.mercymod[obj_orange_enemy.myself] >= 100`. Mercy comes from the ACT menu: Orange's `GetAlong` gives orange +25 / green +20 (obj_orange_enemy_Step_0.gml:446-449) and Green's `FeastX` gives green +25 / orange +20 (obj_green_enemy_Step_0.gml:294-297), mercymax 100 (scr_monstersetup.gml:404-405 / 437-438), so four GetAlongs reach it. Fires exactly ONCE per fight and ends the battle. obj_dbulletcontroller_Step_0.gml:1622-1630 sets `global.turntimer = 615` (overriding the dispatcher's scr_turntimer(300)) and creates obj_attack_orange_superattack at depth -1. That object's Step_0 is literally `exit;` — all 301 lines of logic are in Draw_0. It lerps obj_growtangle.image_xscale to 3, orbits `foodcollected = 10` eggs inward, then rains obj_bullet_orange_debris across the widened box, drawn through a surface clipped to the box (gt_minx/gt_maxx).

real.name: OMEGA PAN — Green's finale, three orbiting pans firing flame fans (admire / Green-mercy ending)
real.evidence: gml_Object_obj_orange_green_controller_Step_0.gml:864-875, same `if (endcon == 2.5) { if (endtimer == 12) }` block. Reached only when `admireending` is true, set at Step_0:128-137 when `global.mercymod[obj_green_enemy.myself] >= 100` (four FeastX acts). Note the dispatcher writes damage TWICE — `__dc.damage = global.monsterat[green] * 5;` then `__dc.damage = 92;` — and pins `__dc.target = 4` (scr_damage.gml:30-49, random party member biased away from the low-HP ones). Fires exactly ONCE per fight. obj_dbulletcontroller_Step_0.gml:3455-3463 creates obj_omega_pan_manager, which in Create_0 REPLACES the battle box sprite and mask with spr_battlebg_round (an 80x80 circle) and spawns three obj_omega_pan at 140 px, 120 degrees apart, shuffled into a ds_list. Step_0 rotates them 0.5 deg/frame with a breathing radius (`120 + 6*cos(global.time * 0.25)`) and a swinging tangential offset, and every 35 frames the next pan in the shuffled list fires a 3-bullet fan of obj_omega_pan_fire (spr_bullet_green_flame, speed 9, gravity -0.3 along its own direction, middle bullet +2 speed). This is the only entry that takes the admire branch, and it is followed by the unique `endcon == 3.1 -> 3.4` Susie/Ralsei praise scene.

real.name: HEALING EGG — turn REPLACEMENT, no bullets, no box, no soul
real.evidence: gml_Object_obj_orange_green_controller_Step_0.gml:516-519 sets healing_egg_con = 1 (Green heals itself) or 2 (Green heals Orange) whenever an enemy is below 70% max HP, and every downstream guard then suppresses the whole bullet turn: Step_0:520 skips obj_growtangle, :532 skips scr_moveheart, :554 skips Orange's punch stance, :580 skips the dbulletcontroller entirely. Step_0:1609-1654 prints `* GREEN cast HEALING EGG on self!/ON ORANGE!`, spawns obj_green_egg_heal, pins `global.turntimer = 999` until the writer and the egg are gone, then drops it to -10 to end the turn. FULLY REACHABLE AND REPEATABLE: both enemies clamp their own HP at 50% of max every single step (obj_orange_enemy_Step_0.gml:1-2 and obj_green_enemy_Step_0.gml:1-2, `if (monsterhp < maxhp * 0.5) monsterhp = maxhp * 0.5;`), so any party that deals more than 30% damage triggers it, and obj_healing_egg_Draw_0.gml:48-58 restores the target to FULL max HP. Also note the enemy-talk phase short-circuits for this: Step_0:139-143 jumps straight to `global.mnfight = 1.5` with no dialogue when either enemy is under 70%. Listed as a real roster entry, not an attack — like Pink's dates, it replaces a turn.

cut.name: powerup == 4 — the entire fifth difficulty tier
cut.evidence: The powerup ladder at gml_Object_obj_orange_green_controller_Step_0.gml:8-21 assigns 0, 1, 2, 3 and then jumps to 5: `if (_progress >= 80 && _progress < 100) powerup = 5;`. There is NO arm that produces 4, and Create_0.gml:43 initialises it to 0; grep for `powerup` across Ch5 shows the only writers are those five lines. Everything gated on `powerup == 4` is therefore dead: the box widening `if (powerup == 4) with (obj_growtangle) maxxscale = 2;` (Step_0:526-530, inside boxBlock — the finale box is 2x by a different route), the Cooking Time cadence `timermax = 8` (obj_attack_green_cookingtime_Draw_0.gml:23-24), and the `foodtype = 2` platter-candy assignment (ibid:106-107). The soul-speed line `if (powerup >= 4) wspeed = 6;` (Step_0:70-74) is not dead but is a NO-OP — `powerup >= 3` two lines above already set 6.

cut.name: Cooking Time `mode == 1` — the low-gravity food variant
cut.evidence: obj_attack_green_cookingtime_Create_0.gml:12 sets `mode = 2` and nothing anywhere ever reassigns it (grep over Ch5: the only writes to this object's `mode` are that Create line). Draw_0:140-141, `if (powerup >= 1 && mode == 1) candy.gravity = choose(0.35, 0.35, 0.1);`, can therefore never run, so the healing food never gets the slow-float variant. Its sibling at Draw_0:74-75 tests `mode == 2` and DOES run, giving the green flame bullets `choose(0.35, 0.45, 0.25)` gravity at powerup >= 1.

cut.name: treasurehunter — the food-magnet modifier
cut.evidence: obj_bullet_healing_Step_0.gml:24-29 makes every food item home 6 px/frame toward the soul when `obj_orange_green_controller.treasurehunter` is true and the soul is within 30 px. obj_orange_green_controller_Create_0.gml:41 sets `treasurehunter = false;` and that is the ONLY assignment in Chapter 5 (grep returns one hit outside the reader). Four more Create-only variables are fully vestigial with neither reader nor second writer: `heartspeed` (Create_0:42), `admiregreenonly` (:44), `condescendorangeonly` (:45), `admirecount` (:37), `condescendcount` (:38), `afterbullettimer` (:18). `afterbulletcon` (:17) has a READER — obj_battlecontroller_Step_0.gml:29 exits the whole battle step while it is > 0 — but no writer, so that hook is dead too.

cut.name: obj_bullet_green_food / obj_omelet_cut — orphan bullet objects
cut.evidence: obj_bullet_green_food (objects.tsv:787, parent obj_collidebullet, sprite spr_bullet_green_egg, with Create/Step/Draw/Other_15) and obj_omelet_cut (objects.tsv:831, sprite spr_bullet_green_egg_half) have NO creator anywhere in Chapter 5 — a recursive grep for each name outside its own event files returns zero hits. The shipped fight uses obj_bullet_healing (which has no parent at all) for food and obj_omelet_marker for the punched-food trophies instead. obj_bullet_green_food_Other_15.gml is a graze-style `scr_tensionheal(2.5)` handler that never fires.

exclusions.obj_enemy_orange_example: DEV TEMPLATE, not part of the fight. Confirmed: it is never instantiated (recursive grep over all of Ch5 finds only three self-references, inside its own obj_enemy_orange_example_Draw_0.gml, which reach across to obj_enemy_green_example). It has no scr_enemy_object_init(), no obj_monsterparent, no entry in scr_encountersetup and no RoomCC. Its Create_0 does its own `instance_create(320, 170, obj_growtangle)` with hard-coded screen coordinates and a `foodcollected = irandom(4) + 2` — a standalone sandbox for prototyping the food attack. Its 461-line Draw_0 is the ancestor of obj_attack_green_cookingtime / obj_attack_orange_superattack.
exclusions.obj_enemy_green_example: DEV TEMPLATE, same reasoning. Never instantiated; only obj_enemy_orange_example_Draw_0.gml mentions it. Note its Draw_0:68 reads `obj_orange_green_controller.powerup`, which is the one line that makes it look connected — but nothing ever creates it, so that read never executes.
exclusions.obj_orangeheart_enemy: NOT PART OF THIS FIGHT — the starting lead was wrong. The whole obj_orangeheart* family is the ORANGE SOUL platformer mode and belongs to FLOWERY, not to Orange the enemy; the shared prefix is a coincidence of colour naming. obj_orangeheart_enemy has exactly two references in Chapter 5, both in gml_Object_obj_debug_orangeheartcontroller_Step_0.gml:948-949, and obj_debug_orangeheartcontroller is created by obj_dbulletcontroller type 620, whose only writer is gml_Object_obj_flowery_enemy_Step_0.gml:1222. obj_orangeheart_enemy_Create_0.gml:14 even sets `sprite_index = spr_flowery_walk_left_jacket_hand_up`. Neither obj_orange_enemy, obj_green_enemy nor obj_orange_green_controller mentions obj_orangeheart in any form.

mechanics:
STORY BATTLE, ONE ENCOUNTER, MERCY-ONLY. Launched exactly once, by `scr_battle(221, 3, orange_marker, green_marker, 0);` at gml_Object_obj_ch5_DWCR03_Step_0.gml:1055 (room_dw_fcastle_green_orange_battle). Encounter 221 (scr_encountersetup.gml:826-836) places obj_orange_enemy at xx+500/yy+103 as monstertype 113 and obj_green_enemy at xx+493/yy+180 as monstertype 114, battlemsg `* Green brings the food!&* Orange brings the fight!`. Both are 2060 HP / AT 16 / DF 0 / 0 EXP / 400 gold / sparepoint 0 / mercymax 100 (scr_monstersetup.gml:395-423 and 425-455). YOU CANNOT KILL THEM: the first two lines of BOTH enemy Steps clamp `global.monsterhp[myself]` up to `maxhp * 0.5` every frame, so HP never drops below 50%. The fight ends only when one of them reaches 100 mercy.

DISPATCH IS A TWO-LEVEL BOOLEAN, NOT A SELECTOR. The whole fight is four `instance_create(..., obj_dbulletcontroller)` calls in obj_orange_green_controller_Step_0.gml (589, 604, 860, 871). Per-turn: `if (obj_orange_enemy.uppercut_life < 1) type 314 else type 131` at rtimer 12 of the bullets phase, both suppressed entirely when healing_egg_con != 0. Finale: `if (condescendending) type 132` / `if (admireending) type 307` at endcon 2.5 / endtimer 12. There is no monsterattackname, no rr ladder, no myattackchoice. `rr` is a DECOY exactly like the Watercooler's: Create_0:7 sets it to 0 and Step_0:647 does `rr = choose(0, 1, 2)` purely to pick one of three battle messages.

THE CORE MINIGAME — OMELET CATCH. During every type-131 turn Green rains food (obj_bullet_healing) and green flame bullets. Catching food with the soul heals all three heroes 1 HP and gives 4 TP each (obj_bullet_healing_Step_0.gml:99-207 — scr_healall(1), scr_tensionheal(4) per hero, and dead heroes are revived to 1 HP). Any food that falls past `obj_growtangle.y + 100` gets PUNCHED by Orange, who slides in from the box's left edge, plays spr_orange_punch_omelet, converts the food into an obj_omelet_marker trophy, and decrements `uppercut_life` (obj_orange_enemy_Step_0.gml:541-594, clamped at -3). uppercut_life starts at 5. When it hits 0 or below, that turn's Cooking Time ENDS EARLY and turns into a scripted eat-and-power-up sequence — obj_orange_enemy_Step_0.gml:623-624 forces `global.turntimer = 2` once all bullets are gone, then :626-637 rewrites it to 170 and sets punchomeletcon = 2, which flies Orange to the box centre, quadruple-afterimages him, rockets him off the top of the screen, drops him back on his start position with a screen shake and `global.turntimer = 30` (:794-817), then heals him `healamount` HP at turntimer 5 (:819-845). THE NEXT enemy turn is the type-314 uppercut, after which uppercut_life resets to 5. The HUD for this is the 5-egg ring drawn around Orange (obj_orange_enemy_Draw_0.gml:96-155); at uppercut_life -1/-2/-3 it draws 6/7/8 eggs instead.

POWERUP — the difficulty axis. obj_orange_green_controller_Step_0.gml:1-22 recomputes `powerup` from mercy every frame: 0-19 -> 0, 20-39 -> 1, 40-59 -> 2, 60-79 -> 3, 80-99 -> 5. Note the input at :3-6 is a DECOMPILER ODDITY that must be transpiled literally: `var _progress = global.mercymod[green]; if ((_progress == global.mercymod[green]) < global.mercymod[orange]) _progress = global.mercymod[orange];` — the inner comparison is always true, so it reduces to `if (1 < mercymod[orange]) _progress = mercymod[orange];`. It is NOT a max(); it takes ORANGE's mercy whenever Orange has more than 1, and only falls back to Green's at the very start. "Fixing" it to a max() changes the fight. powerup drives Cooking Time's drop cadence and food type, and the soul's own walk speed (type 131: 4 -> 7 at powerup >= 1, -> 10 at powerup >= 5; type 314: 5 / 6 / 7). At powerup 5 the `(mode2count % 3) == 0` flame-bullet branch is skipped entirely — the box is pure food, but the soul is moving at 10 px/frame.

HEROES SHAKE. obj_orange_green_controller_Step_0.gml:633-645 and 1588-1607: if the party catches ALL the food (uppercut_life unchanged across a turn) for 1/2/3 consecutive turns, `heroes_shake` becomes 1/2/3 and every obj_heroparent jitters +/-1, +/-2 or +/-3 px outside the bullets phase, with the battle message `* It's getting very hard to stay still!`. Cosmetic, but it is the only visible payoff for a perfect turn.

DIALOGUE STATE MACHINE.
